comment: EPO03 accepted atlas regions for team south, in blit order. A region appears here ONLY after the single-defect loop ACCEPT (generate -> composite -> guards -> full atlas + x2 perimeter + 197x426 phone FOV -> verdict). Fields: id, x, y, w, h (crop origin/size on the 1024^2 atlas; <id>.png and <id>_mask.png are exactly w x h), salt (>= 40, unique across all five manifests), status, job, seed, atlas, review, team, reauthorizes (landmark golden ids this region overwrites; each is re-extracted in the same commit — DECISIONS/0033).

regions.intent: The delta shore: marsh wets into grey silt in fingers, braided channels converge into one trunk reaching the sea; a broad sand beach with angled dune ridges and machair runs across the middle, one creek cuts it at a rock headland, surf and shallows follow it; the wooded headland sand rim continues as a spit hooking south. Roll 1 (seed 6001) rejected: the flats ran too far south and drowned the Sunward Strand beach.

No sea reaches this ground, so no beach: the interior sand belt becomes rough grazing, heath, gorse, bracken, boulders and a winding beck; the SW wood breaks out of its straight top edge into bays and stepping copses; the blue-rimmed orchard becomes ordinary broadleaf; machair only at the far right where S1 dune belt begins; the reserved storm-knoll pocket left plain.

regions.postprocess: tools/conform-region-water.js — the open-water interior of the generation is remapped to the atlas sea dialect (ocean_unify TGT palette, mean/std + nearest-palette snap, 9x9 >=80% deep guard). Deterministic, A-2. Roll 1 (seed 6003) rejected: the SW wood was cleared into a dead zone.
regions.intent: The SW corner: the vertical turquoise shore becomes a curving coast with a rocky headland, a bay, varying sand width, surf, angled dune ridges, machair and a creek; the wood is kept and only its straight western and northern edges break into copses; the lime slab becomes textured heath; the reserved storm-knoll pocket left plain.

Close the Sunward Strand identity anchor (D0033 3): the dune field reaches inland in rounded tongues with marram tufts so sand and machair interlock and the marker at (511,860) stands on the strand. Its own region entry, not a re-touch of S1. Ramps 14 px, not 32 — see regions_south.json rampNote.
